thread:
maria: Hey, infra/gke pipeline just failed during apply for region-us-west1. Got a quota error and left a half-created nodepool.

maria: Logs:
```
terraform apply -auto-approve
googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'NVIDIA_GPUS' exceeded for project 12345 in region us-west1
Error: Error creating NodePool: googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded
``` 

aj: Ugh. Did the run overlap with another deploy? We had concurrency group set to just `infra` instead of per-region.

devon: I saw two GH Actions runs start within 20s — matrix(region) + no concurrency per-region. Cache restore also failed in one run:
```
Restore cache key: infra-cache-us-west1
Error: Server responded 403 Forbidden - signature expired
```

maria: Re-ran the job and it reclaimed the partial nodepool but we hit GPU quota when recreating. Need to clean up the half nodes manually. 

aj: Short term: manual cleanup + request quota bump? Long term: add `concurrency: group: infra-${{ matrix.region }}` and enforce plan/app lock.

devon: Also add a terraform state lock using DynamoDB table for the repo (we sometimes skip lock in apply job to speed things up). If lock exists it would block the second apply.

sre-oncall: FYI I cleaned up the orphan instances (gke nodepool partials) and freed 12 GPUs. Requested quota increase just in case.

ci-bot: Workflow run 789012 re-run by @maria : repeating apply now using per-region concurrency.

aj: Let's also add retry logic around cache restore and pin the actions/cache version and bump timeout to 5m.

maria: I'll open a quick PR adding concurrency per-region + DynamoDB lock + cache retries. Will tag you all. :+1:

devon: Thanks — also add a health-check step after apply to detect partial nodepools earlier (fail fast).

sre-oncall: Noted. Rolling patch to infra CI should prevent duplicate nodepool creation races.
